source_of_truth: Explicit founder decisions and verified implementation; recheck live external status

decisions.title: Decision: first Chile prospect demo is POS-independent local kitchen plus pay at pickup
decisions.detail: A restaurant partner and POS access do not exist yet. Complete the standalone demo before restaurant onboarding. Both Toteat and Fudo remain subsequent pilot connector targets; one configured destination per order.

decisions.title: Blocker: Meta legal business verification deferred; profile completion is a separate prerequisite
decisions.detail: Founder company registration is pending. Meta developer app/test sender and desktop MCP OAuth were created. Last MCP observation found business unverified and profile incomplete. Do not invent legal details or assume every test-sender operation is impossible; recheck actual eligibility. Cloud agents do not inherit desktop OAuth or secrets.

decisions.title: Blocker: Toteat and Fudo lack approved restaurant accounts, contracts and kitchen acceptance evidence
decisions.detail: Build common boundaries and explicitly synthetic harnesses now. Verify official authorized request contracts before actual adapters. Generic API access, fake IDs and local references are not vendor order-injection or payment-link proof.

decisions.title: Blocker: Webpay sandbox creation received security-page HTTP 403; no successful hosted checkout yet
decisions.detail: Independent sandbox checkout is authorized as demo scope. Published integration credentials exist in the official example. Implement server-priced attempts, POST handoff and authoritative commit/status with mocks now; real sandbox success and production merchant settlement are distinct gates. No security bypass or simulated approval presented as real.

decisions.title: Invariant: Spanish default plus complete English testing; CLP integer totals and Santiago dates
decisions.detail: The founder cannot read Spanish. Preserve cart/order data across locale switches. QR menu is optional and cannot gate WhatsApp ordering or the shared catalog.

decisions.title: Implemented: durable WhatsApp jobs; uncertain sends pause for review, not blind replay
decisions.detail: Merged PR29 supplies persisted ACK, atomic domain/reply work, per-conversation sequencing and bounded explicit-rejection retries. Cloud delivery adds redacted scoped recovery: failed jobs can be retried; uncertain sends can be reviewed without resend. Resolution is not delivery confirmation. Provider status callbacks, retention and real-phone acceptance remain open in issue10.

decisions.title: Authorization: cloud orchestrator may spawn bounded specialist subagents and finish independent pilot work
decisions.detail: Use isolated branches/worktrees, centrally reserve migrations/shared contracts and integrate meaningful tests. Do not contact vendors, approve legal terms, activate billing, migrate live senders or claim blocked acceptance complete. Update this context layer and GitHub evidence after each slice.

decisions.title: Evidence: cloud recovery, sandbox adapter mocks and bilingual local HTTP rehearsal
decisions.detail: Recovery migration005 and six TAP results; five sandbox adapter mock HTTP tests; real local rehearsal script for pay at pickup and both simulated POS labels. GitHub REST/GraphQL denied; pending issue updates stored locally. No real provider or hosted sandbox acceptance claimed.
